description: Change request and recertification assessment for a certified slot game. See steering/change-management-recert.md.
governingPrinciple: Certification binds a BUILD, not a product. Every deployment must be able to answer: does this build hash correspond to a valid certification report, and if not, does the change fall within a permitted no-notification scope? The default position is that recertification IS required, because the cost of unnecessary re-testing is far lower than the cost of running uncertified software.

referenceStandards.name: Danish certification programme SCP.06 (change management)
referenceStandards.note: Publicly available and usable as an internal process skeleton

referenceStandards.name: AGCO Internet Gaming Notification Matrix, March 2026 v1.6
referenceStandards.note: Item-by-item notification requirements; useful as a template even outside Ontario

changeRequest.changeReason: feature | defect-fix | regulatory-change | security | performance | commercial

classification.category: A | B | C | D | E | F | G | H | I | J

categoryDefinitions.A: Mathematics model: paytable, reel strips, RTP target, volatility, feature probabilities, jackpot contribution rate. Recertification REQUIRED.
categoryDefinitions.B: RNG: algorithm, entropy source, seeding, scaling or mapping logic. Recertification REQUIRED.
categoryDefinitions.C: Game rules: wild substitution, scatter determination, payline definitions, multiplier application, evaluation order. Recertification REQUIRED.
categoryDefinitions.D: Product constraints: game cycle time, stake limits or tiers, autoplay, turbo, multi-game. Recertification REQUIRED.
categoryDefinitions.E: Responsible gambling functions: limits, self-exclusion integration, session reminders, net position display, forced breaks. Market-dependent.
categoryDefinitions.F: System architecture: RGS, wallet, PAM, jackpot controller, logging subsystem, deployment location. Market-dependent.
categoryDefinitions.G: Disclosure content: RTP text, rules description, maximum-prize probability. Market-dependent.
categoryDefinitions.H: Presentation layer only: art assets, sound, animation, localisation not touching rules or disclosure. Usually exempt.
categoryDefinitions.I: Defect fix: classify by the scope of the fix.
categoryDefinitions.J: Security update: dependency upgrades, patches. Assess by impact.

misclassificationChecks.description: Changes that look like category H but are not. Each must be answered before a change can be treated as presentation-only.

checks.question: Does the change reduce the time from game start to result, or the game cycle duration?
checks.consequence: Category D. May breach UK RTS 14D 2500 ms, German 5000 ms average, Ontario 2.18.

checks.question: Does the change add or alter any ability to shorten the time to result (skip animation, tap to stop)?
checks.consequence: Category D. Prohibited by UK RTS 14E and Ontario 2.19.

checks.question: Does the change alter when win audio or visual feedback is triggered?
checks.consequence: Category D. Celebrating returns at or below the stake breaches UK RTS 14F and Ontario 2.20.

checks.question: Does the localisation touch rules text, RTP disclosure or maximum-prize probability?
Does the change alter demo or free-play behaviour?
checks.consequence: Sweden Spellag 14:5 requires free play to share the same outcome distribution as staked play.

checks.question: Does the change add a currency, points or unit conversion display?
Does the change alter reel-stop presentation or symbol positioning near paylines?
Does the change only hide an autoplay control in the UI while the server still accepts consecutive spin requests?
checks.consequence: The feature still exists for audit purposes. Must be enforced server-side.

checks.question: Does the change upgrade any dependency, altering the build hash?
checks.consequence: Category J. Build no longer matches the certified hash.

impactAssessment.verificationEvidence: Reference the re-run results from steering/math-verification.md section 6 checklist

marketSpecificNotes.germany: Each individual slot game requires prior GGL permission, a playable version must be supplied, and MATERIAL CHANGES REQUIRE FRESH PERMISSION. Permission is revocable at any time and unpermitted slots constitute illegal gambling. Treat German changes as a sequential external dependency in the schedule.
marketSpecificNotes.ontario: Standard 4.08 expressly covers SUBSEQUENT MODIFICATIONS to games, RNGs and system components. Consult the AGCO Internet Gaming Notification Matrix for the applicable notification route.
marketSpecificNotes.unitedKingdom: Games and RNG results must be filed to the Games Register before release. Annual games-testing audit and annual independent security audit also apply.
marketSpecificNotes.denmark: SCP.06 governs change management. Since 2025 licence holders and game suppliers each submit their own certifications directly.
marketSpecificNotes.brazil: Certification filings are in Portuguese via SIGAP. Confirm the certifier's current accreditation standing before engaging, as authorisations have been revoked.

buildCertificationMappingTable.description: The record most frequently requested during an audit. If the current production build cannot be tied to a certification report on demand, the audit outcome is usually adverse.
